# `codes.grow.packages:better-stack-logs` — agent quickstart (Java 17+)

Ships inside the jar at `META-INF/grow/better-stack-logs/AGENTS.md`
(`unzip -p better-stack-logs-X.Y.Z.jar META-INF/grow/better-stack-logs/AGENTS.md`). Docs:
https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/better-stack-logs/ · Service: Better Stack Logs · Categories: logging ·
Package `codes.grow.packages.betterstack`.

## Client

```java
try (BetterStackClient client = BetterStackClient.fromEnv()) { // GROW_BETTER_STACK_LOGS_* > vendor env > defaults
  client.health();
}
```

Errors: `BetterStackException` subclasses (`ConfigException`, `NotFoundException`, …) with `code()`.

## Logging: one call

```java
import codes.grow.packages.betterstack.logging.LoggingInit;
LoggingInit.LoggingHandle log =
    LoggingInit.initLogging(LoggingInit.InitOptions.builder().service("orders").build());
log.logger().info("started");
// servlet / Spring Boot: new RequestLoggingFilter(log.logger()); Logback: GrowLogbackAppender with log.client()
```

- JSON lines on stdout (`time`, `level`, `msg`, `service`, `environment`, `request_id`, `trace_id`, attributes,
  redacted); with `GROW_LOGGING_PROVIDER=better-stack-logs` also shipped (`log_shipped:"sdk"`, failed exports re-emitted
  with `"sdk_failed"`). Handle: `logger()`, `client()`, `shipped()`, `flush()`, `close()`, `canary(msg, attrs)`.
- `LoggingInit.withRequestId(id, runnable)`, `currentRequestId()`.
